RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, meaning sex was not a discriminatory factor in the selection. An all-female panel appointing a woman provides no evidence of sex bias, and questioning the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and damage your professional credibility.

The announcement pointed to a clear, legitimate qualification: strong digital media experience, an area public broadcasters heavily prioritize. Instead of raising the panel's composition, send a polite follow-up requesting the delayed written feedback to understand how you can strengthen your digital profile for future openings. If you suspect age—rather than sex—played a role given the experience gap, evaluate that only after reviewing their formal feedback.
